upper-lake.title: Upper Lake
upper-lake.summary: A broad, calm horizon at the heart of Bhopal.
upper-lake.story: Bhojtal, often called Upper Lake, has shaped Bhopal’s rhythm for centuries. Its shoreline opens into changing views of the old city and surrounding hills.

moti-masjid.title: Moti Masjid

moti-masjid.story: Moti Masjid, also known as the Pearl Mosque, is a compact landmark among the lanes and markets of Bhopal’s historic centre.
